edition.check: 5: INPUT contains a barcode matching in >= 2 sources -> NOT MET (input has no barcode). 4: Without barcode, title, artist, format and >= 1 further attribute unambiguous in >= 2 sources and no other fitting edition has a different tracklist -> NOT MET (input gives no further attribute, and tool call 2 tl-mb search shows other Vinyl editions fitting the input with different tracklists, e.g. musicbrainz:release/4375c18f-f160-44d0-ae2b-795f1dd5870f with 22 tracks). 3: Unambiguous in one source or all fitting editions share the same tracklist -> NOT MET (musicbrainz:release/4375c18f-f160-44d0-ae2b-795f1dd5870f 10th anniversary 3x Vinyl has 22 tracks vs 13 tracks on musicbrainz:release/4867ceba-ffe7-40c0-a093-45be6c03c655). 2: Several editions fit the input and at least one has a DIFFERENT tracklist; choice rests on weak signals -> MET (input only specifies title, artist, and Vinyl, leaving standard 13-track 2xLP vs 22-track 10th anniversary Vinyl edition unresolved; choice of 2013 standard edition rests on assuming un-qualified input means the original album).
edition.summary: The input lacks barcode, year, or edition details, so competing Vinyl editions with different tracklists (such as the 22-track 10th Anniversary Edition) also fit.

tracklist.check: 5: >= 2 independent sources of the same edition agree on count, order and titles (spelling variants only) -> MET (musicbrainz:release/4867ceba-ffe7-40c0-a093-45be6c03c655 in tool call 5 and discogs:release/4570366 in tool call 6 both represent the 2013 original pressing Columbia 88883716861 / barcode 888837168618 and agree completely on all 13 tracks, positions A1-D4, order, and titles, differing only in capitalization/apostrophe variants).
tracklist.summary: Both independent database entries for the 2013 Columbia 88883716861 2xLP agree on all 13 track positions, order, and titles.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 100% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 0 conflicts

sources.check: 5: Database + independent primary source (cover/booklet/label print, label or manufacturer info) of the same edition -> NOT MET (only two databases were queried; no cover images, booklet, or manufacturer pages were inspected). 4: Two independent database entries (recognisable by differing details) or database + specialised collector site -> MET (musicbrainz:release/4867ceba-ffe7-40c0-a093-45be6c03c655 and discogs:release/4570366 are two independent database entries with differing details such as country DE vs UK, Europe & US, title capitalization, and track durations differing by 1-2 s on A1, A2, C2, and D4).
sources.summary: The result is backed by two independent database entries (MusicBrainz and Discogs) identifiable by differing metadata and duration details.

concerns: FACTS reports a validation error: artists is empty (the output lacks the top-level artists list of distinct main/featured artists on the carrier).

The agent marked status as found despite competing Vinyl editions with differing tracklists fitting the input (e.g. musicbrainz:release/4375c18f-f160-44d0-ae2b-795f1dd5870f with 22 tracks and musicbrainz:release/fc1eb6d6-1c46-429a-8332-4f881c541ae7 with 34 tracks).
